ownership.quote: Kamatera's parent company, The OMC Group, was founded in 1995 by brothers Assaf and Yohai Azulai. The OMC Group owns several subsidiaries operating in the fields of cloud computing and software development, including ReutOne... and several cloud infrastructure companies including ClubVPS, GNS Cloud Solutions, VPSServer.com, CaaB-Cloud as a Business, JetServer, and Kamatera.

stage.quote: Kamatera is a US-based cloud provider founded in 1995. ... Kamatera's parent company, The OMC Group, was founded in 1995 by brothers Assaf and Yohai Azulai.
stage.note: No VC funding, accelerator, acquisition-by-outside-party, or public listing was found for Kamatera or its parent The OMC Group in any source reachable during research (Crunchbase, Tracxn, ZoomInfo, RocketReach, Growjo, HostAdvice all returned anti-bot blocks). Kamatera has operated as a privately-held, family-founded subsidiary of The OMC Group since 1995 and itself acquired a smaller competitor (VPSServer.com) in 2023, consistent with a self-funded/profitable private company rather than a VC-backed startup. Classified as bootstrapped on that basis, but treat with only medium confidence since a definitive funding-history source could not be reached.

note: Kamatera is a subsidiary of The OMC Group (founded 1995 by brothers Assaf and Yohai Azulai), which also owns ReutOne, Tyco, ClubVPS, GNS Cloud Solutions, VPSServer.com, CaaB-Cloud as a Business, and JetServer. In 2023 Kamatera itself acquired VPSServer.com, a Netherlands-based VPS host. As of 2024 Kamatera runs data centers in 24 locations across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. No evidence of external VC funding, accelerator participation, acquisition by an outside company, or a public listing was found; most third-party data aggregators (Crunchbase, Tracxn, ZoomInfo, RocketReach, Growjo, HostAdvice) were inaccessible behind anti-bot protections during this research session, so funding/revenue figures could not be confirmed and are left null rather than guessed.
